territorial_scope.description: Applies to establishments in the Rio de Janeiro state that are installed or to be installed there.

evidence.quote: que vierem a se instalar ou já instaladas no Estado do Rio de Janeiro

summary.short: Rio de Janeiro state law granting a differentiated ICMS tax regime to companies whose main activity is CNAE 6311-9/00 (data processing, application and internet hosting services) that install or operate in the state, effective on publication and running to 31 December 2032.
summary.long: Rio de Janeiro state statute of 21 June 2024 creating a differentiated ICMS tax regime for companies whose main economic activity is CNAE 6311-9/00 (data processing, application service providers and internet hosting) that establish or already operate in the state. It partially adopts the benefits of Espírito Santo's Law 10.550/2016 under LC 160/2017 and ICMS Convênio 190/2017. Art. 2 grants ICMS deferral on imports, interstate purchases (rate differential) and internal sales of equipment for fixed assets, and an exemption for goods used for construction or expansion; covered equipment includes servers, switches and optical transceivers identified by Mercosur NCM codes. The deferred tax is payable by the acquirer on disposal. Benefits are conditioned on proof of listed requirements (use of state port and airport infrastructure, customs clearance in the state, capacity expansion, or 12 months of suspended activity for revitalization); the Executive regulates proof. Art. 3 requires at least one of six conditions, such as job creation or use of state inputs, and excludes Simples Nacional opt-ins. Art. 4 refers procedure to Lei Estadual 8.445/2019. Art. 5 removes the regime for irregularities after a 30-day notice to cure, with ordinary ICMS then due. Art. 6 revokes Lei 9.510/2021. Art. 7: in force on publication, effects until 31 December 2032.

notes: The text names no firms or facilities; the taxpayer role is generic ('contribuinte', 'estabelecimento'). Benefits are conditioned on proof of listed conditions (Art. 2 § 4º), and their form is left to executive regulation (§ 5º). Art. 7 sets effect until 31 December 2032. Art. 3 Parágrafo único excludes Simples Nacional establishments. Drafting points: Art. 5 § 1 ends with 'sob pena de excluído', which reads as incomplete; Art. 6 revokes Lei nº 9.510/2021 without describing it. obligations.summary: Incentives under Art. 2 are conditional on proof of compliance with the conditions in § 4 (a: use of the State's port and airport infrastructure; b: clearance of imported equipment in the State; c: expansion or diversification of productive capacity for expansion projects; d: no suspension of activities in the 12 months before the application for revitalization projects).
obligations.applies_from: Before the grant of the incentives (text does not state a date)
obligations.conditional_on: Enterprise seeks the tax incentives under Art. 2 § 1

evidence.quote: A concessão dos incentivos fiscais tratados neste artigo ficam condicionadas à comprovação do cumprimento das seguintes condicionantes

obligations.summary: The Executive Power shall regulate the form of proof of the Art. 2 § 4 conditions.

evidence.quote: O Poder Executivo regulamentará a forma de comprovação das condicionantes descritas no § 4º

obligations.summary: The acquirer is responsible for the deferred ICMS under Art. 2 § 1 I and must pay it when the goods are sold or otherwise leave the establishment, on the sale value at the normal destination rate.
obligations.applies_from: At the time of sale or any other departure of the goods
obligations.conditional_on: Deferral of ICMS under Art. 2 § 1 I

evidence.quote: O imposto diferido na forma do inciso I será de responsabilidade do adquirente e deverá ser recolhido no momento da alienação

obligations.summary: An establishment that carries on the Art. 1 activity must meet at least one of six conditions to benefit: contributes to employment; represents a non-existent economic activity or makes a product without similar in the State; predominantly uses raw materials, goods and services from the State; is strategic for development; is in a government-priority region; or revitalizes existing logistics infrastructure (items I to VI).
obligations.conditional_on: Establishment carries on the economic activity defined in Art. 1; excludes Simples Nacional opters (Art. 3 sole paragraph)

evidence.quote: Poderá se beneficiar do tratamento tributário diferenciado previsto nesta lei o estabelecimento que exerçam a atividade econômica definida no artigo 1º e que atenda, pelo menos, a uma das seguintes condições

obligations.summary: An establishment wishing to use the tax benefits must follow the procedures of State Law 8.445/2019.

obligations.summary: A taxpayer with any irregularity in meeting the requirements and obligations of the Law loses the differentiated treatment and must pay ICMS under the conventional system within normal deadlines on operations it carries out (Art. 5 caput); under § 2 it still owes conventional ICMS for the period of irregularity even after regularizing.
obligations.conditional_on: Taxpayer has an irregularity regarding requirements and obligations of the Law

evidence.quote: tornar-se-á obrigado a recolher, dentro dos prazos normais, o ICMS que seria devido pelas operações que vier a realizar

obligations.summary: Once an irregularity is found, the taxpayer must be notified and has 30 days to present the missing documentation or cure the irregularity, failing which it is excluded from the regime.
obligations.applies_from: From notification of the irregularity (text does not state the notification date)

enforcement.max_penalty_text: No monetary penalty stated. Loss of the differentiated tax treatment, with restoration of the conventional ICMS system, and the taxpayer must pay the ICMS due on its operations within normal deadlines.
